notes.title: Devlog #1 - Welcome!
notes.content:
Hello space bartenders,

StarKeeper is a unique management simulation game that will take you to an asteroid speeding through space. In this game, you will have the opportunity to build, develop, and manage your own space station, catering to the needs of diverse visitors from different galaxies while exploring the mysteries of the universe.

In our devlogs, we will regularly discuss various aspects of the game, so you can get a closer look at the mechanics we are working on. We will cover topics such as resource management, traveling through star systems, interactions with inhabitants, and many other interesting elements that make up StarKeeper.

We encourage you to follow our updates to stay up-to-date with the progress of the game's development and gain insight into the development process. Thank you for your support, and see you on the asteroid!

notes.title: New management game Starkeeper is a space Stardew Valley, with a twist
notes.content:
Between Stardew Valley, Travellers Rest, and Tavern Keeper it's incredibly easy to cozy up and watch people enjoy the fruits of your labor. Motel management and farming games always opt for the rural, though, so the newly announced Starkeeper is taking us to space instead. Set in a tavern on an asteroid flying across procedurally generated space, every day during this job is unpredictable, on a cosmic scale.
